name: EO Shorts
summary: One click turns a talking-head Draft of up to 95 seconds into a new 9:16 EO-style Short: tightened talk, speaker framing, typographic scenes with pictures and stock B-roll, music and loudness, exported and checked.

compatibility.selects: Needs Panel runScript and askAI, Draft motion graphics with generated-media authoring, and the bundled ffmpeg. Picture generation needs Selects 2.0.512 or later; stock B-roll needs stock footage search. Tested on a development build; released versions are unverified. Shared YuNet framing requires selects.ai and selects-ai-runtime installed from the same library revision (Selects 2.0.570 or later).
